sources.locator: Title search: 评估信息与系统中的安全与隐私控制（SP 800-53A Rev.5）

statement.zh: **标准**：评估信息与系统中的安全与隐私控制（SP 800-53A Rev.5）（Assessing Security and Privacy Controls in Information Systems and Organizations (SP 800-53A Rev.摘要首句给出方法与程序两样产出及其框架：「This publication provides a methodology and set of procedures for conducting assessments of security and privacy controls employed within systems and organizations within an effective risk management framework.」次句钉住对齐对象：「The assessment procedures, executed at various phases of the system development life cycle, are consistent with the security and privacy controls in NIST Special Publication 800-53, Revision 5.
statement.en: **Standard**: Assessing Security and Privacy Controls in Information Systems and Organizations (SP 800-53A Rev.5) (评估信息与系统中的安全与隐私控制（SP 800-53A Rev.5）).

statement.zh: 第一章开篇给出因果位置：「Once employed within a system, security and privacy controls are assessed to determine their overall effectiveness (i.e., the extent to which the controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome with respect to meeting the security and privacy requirements for the system and the organization).」执行摘要先排除一种误用：「Security and privacy control assessments are not about checklists, simple pass/fail results, or generating paperwork to pass inspections or audits.」其下一句给出它真正承担的功能：「Rather, control assessments are the principal vehicle used to verify that selected security and privacy controls are implemented and meeting stated goals and objectives.
statement.en: The opening of Chapter One places the cause and effect: "Once employed within a system, security and privacy controls are assessed to determine their overall effectiveness (i.e., the extent to which the controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome with respect to meeting the security and privacy requirements for the system and the organization)." The Executive Summary first rules a misuse out: "Security and privacy control assessments are not about checklists, simple pass/fail results, or generating paperwork to pass inspections or audits.

statement.zh: 程序与判定责任写在编号章节，主语是 assessors 与 organizations。印出的 2.4 节界定方法与对象（本份文本把它报在 §2.3 名下）：「Assessment methods define the nature of the assessor actions and include examine, interview, and test.」与「Assessment objects identify the specific items being assessed as part of a given control and include specifications, mechanisms, activities, and individuals.」力度选择归组织，同属印出的 2.4 而非 2.3：「The organization determines the assessment methods needed to provide the level of assurance required by the organization.」§1.1 把程序定性为起点而非清单：「The guidance in this publication has been developed with the intention of enabling organizations to tailor the basic assessment procedures provided.
statement.en: The procedures and the judgement duties sit in numbered sections with assessors and organizations as the subjects.The printed Section 2.4, reported by this copy under the label 2.3, bounds methods and objects: "Assessment methods define the nature of the assessor actions and include examine, interview, and test." and "Assessment objects identify the specific items being assessed as part of a given control and include specifications, mechanisms, activities, and individuals." The level of effort is the organisation's call, and that sentence is printed in 2.4 as well: "The organization determines the assessment methods needed to provide the level of assurance required by the organization.

statement.zh: 限度有四处，各自不同层。§1.1 划适用面：「The security and privacy guidelines in this publication are applicable to federal systems other than those systems designated as national security systems, as defined in 44 U.S.C., Section 3542.」Authority 段的措辞是条件式的：「Such information security standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of the appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems.」§1.1 的脚注把更细的执行层交出去：「Such test scripts are at a lower level of detail than provided by the assessment procedures contained in this guidance and are, therefore, beyond the scope of this publication.
statement.en: The four limits sit at different levels.Section 1.1 draws the applicability line: "The security and privacy guidelines in this publication are applicable to federal systems other than those systems designated as national security systems, as defined in 44 U.S.C., Section 3542." The Authority block states the same bound conditionally: "Such information security standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of the appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems." A footnote in §1.

statement.zh: 扉页三行按连排印为一个块「NIST Special Publication 800-53A Revision 5 Assessing Security and Privacy Controls in Information Systems and Organizations JOINT TASK FORCE」，署名不是个人而是跨部门工作组；日期由引用行给出页数与日期「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-53A, Rev.5, 733 pages (January 2022) CODEN: NSPUE2」，免费获取行是「This publication is available free of charge from:」，其后是 DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-53Ar5。工作组身份由致谢页首句给出：「This publication was developed by the Joint Task Force Interagency Working Group.」该页另把前任贡献者按名册列出，并记本系列的起点：「The authors wanted to acknowledge the many individuals who contributed to previous versions of Special Publication 800-53A since its inception in 2005.」被点名的官员含国防部条目的「HON.
statement.en: The title block prints its three lines as one run, "NIST Special Publication 800-53A Revision 5 Assessing Security and Privacy Controls in Information Systems and Organizations JOINT TASK FORCE", the signature being an interagency body rather than named individuals; the date comes from the citation line, "Natl.Inst.
